title: Azure diagnostic or Activity Log export deleted
description: Detects a successful administrative deletion of an Azure diagnostic setting or legacy Activity Log export profile.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may delete diagnostic settings or Activity Log export to interrupt an established external audit trail and reduce visibility of subsequent actions.
hypothesis.rationale: Deleting one export configuration does not prove logging ceased elsewhere. Resource retirement and replacement can emit the same event.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Detects a successful administrative deletion of an Azure diagnostic setting or legacy Activity Log export profile.

triage.summary: Deleting one export configuration does not prove logging ceased elsewhere. Resource retirement and replacement can emit the same event.
steps: Review the operation, resource, caller, source address and correlation ID; establish the approved change or recovery owner.
Inspect effective post-change configuration and independent controls, then correlate related role, resource and logging changes.
Validate the business justification and restore the affected control or contain unauthorized access through the consumer's approved process.
false_positives: Approved diagnostic-setting replacement, resource decommissioning or retirement of a legacy Activity Log profile.

validation.expected_outcome: Match the bounded event, key/action/path or successful operation combination; reject one-field mutations, lookalikes and absent required fields. Synthetic tests do not establish live telemetry or production performance.

limitations: Deleting one export configuration does not prove logging ceased elsewhere. Resource retirement and replacement can emit the same event.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
